mapper.insert: INSERT INTO QR_TOKEN (TOKEN_ID, TOKEN, EXPIRES_AT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (QR_TOKEN_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{token}, SYSDATE + 5/1440, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT TOKEN_ID, TOKEN, TO_CHAR(EXPIRES_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS EXPIRES_AT, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT TOKEN_ID, TOKEN, EXPIRES_AT, CREATED_AT FROM QR_TOKEN WHERE EXPIRES_AT > SYSDATE ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT TOKEN_ID, TOKEN, TO_CHAR(EXPIRES_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS EXPIRES_AT, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT FROM QR_TOKEN WHERE TOKEN = #{token} AND EXPIRES_AT > SYSDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM QR_TOKEN WHERE EXPIRES_AT <= SYSDATE
